name: /play
description: Open Vortexia’s interactive music player.
usage: Join a voice channel, then run `/play`. Use the player controls to search, select, queue and control tracks.

name: /tempban
description: Schedule a temporary ban that automatically expires.
usage: Use `/tempban add`, select a member, enter a duration such as `2h` or `1d`, and optionally add a reason. Use `remove`, `list` or `info` to manage it.

name: /temprole
description: Give a member a role for a limited time.
usage: Use `/temprole add`, select the member and role, then enter a duration such as `30m` or `7d`. The role is removed automatically when time expires.

name: /automod
description: Configure or run a server moderation and safety tool.
usage: Run `/automod` using Discord’s slash-command picker, then complete the required member, duration, rule or setting fields. You need the required server permissions.

name: /banwords
description: Configure or run a server moderation and safety tool.
usage: Run `/banwords` using Discord’s slash-command picker, then complete the required member, duration, rule or setting fields. You need the required server permissions.

name: /strikes
description: Configure or run a server moderation and safety tool.
usage: Run `/strikes` using Discord’s slash-command picker, then complete the required member, duration, rule or setting fields. You need the required server permissions.

name: /logs set
description: Choose where server event and moderation logs are sent.
usage: Run `/logs set` and select the destination channel.

name: /logs toggle
description: Enable or pause event logging.
usage: Run `/logs toggle` and follow the option shown by Discord.

name: /logs status
description: View the current logging configuration.
usage: Run `/logs status`.

name: /logs disable
description: Disable the configured logging system.
usage: Run `/logs disable`.

name: /autoreact add
description: Add an automatic reaction for a channel.
usage: Run `/autoreact add`, select a channel, then enter a Unicode or custom emoji. Up to five reactions can be configured per channel.

name: /autoreact remove
description: Remove an automatic channel reaction.
usage: Run `/autoreact remove`, select the channel and enter the exact emoji configured for removal.

name: /autoreact list
description: List automatic reactions configured for a channel.
usage: Run `/autoreact list` and optionally select a channel.

name: /welcome
description: Configure automatic welcome messages for new members.
usage: Run `/welcome` and choose the setup options Discord displays, such as the destination channel and message.

name: /goodbye setup
description: Configure the message sent when a member leaves.
usage: Run `/goodbye setup`, choose the text channel, and optionally customize the message with `{user}`, `{username}`, `{server}` or `{membercount}`.

name: /goodbye status
description: Show the current goodbye-message configuration.
usage: Run `/goodbye status` in your server.

name: /goodbye disable
description: Turn off automatic goodbye messages.
usage: Run `/goodbye disable`.

name: /boostreminder setup
description: Set up announcements when a member boosts your server.
usage: Run `/boostreminder setup`, choose an announcement channel, and optionally customize the message with `{user}`, `{username}` or `{server}`.

name: /boostreminder status
description: Show boost-announcement settings.
usage: Run `/boostreminder status`.

name: /boostreminder disable
description: Disable boost announcements.
usage: Run `/boostreminder disable`.

name: /reactionrole panel
description: Create a reaction-role panel members can use to select roles.
usage: Run `/reactionrole panel` and follow the prompts to choose a channel and panel settings.

name: /reactionrole add
description: Add a role option to a reaction-role panel.
usage: Run `/reactionrole add`, then choose the panel, emoji and role.

name: /reactionrole remove
description: Remove an option from a reaction-role panel.
usage: Run `/reactionrole remove` and select the option to remove.

name: /reactionrole list
description: List configured reaction-role panels.
usage: Run `/reactionrole list`.

name: /verify setup
description: Set up the server verification flow.
usage: Run `/verify setup` and choose the verification channel and role requested by Discord.

name: /verify status
description: Check verification settings.
usage: Run `/verify status`.

name: /verify disable
description: Disable the verification system.
usage: Run `/verify disable`.

name: /voicemaster setup
description: Configure temporary voice-channel creation.
usage: Run `/voicemaster setup` and select the join-to-create channel and category/options shown.

name: /voicemaster panel
description: Open or post the VoiceMaster control panel.
usage: Run `/voicemaster panel` and follow the channel prompt.

name: /voicemaster status
description: Show VoiceMaster configuration.
usage: Run `/voicemaster status`.

name: /voicemaster disable
description: Disable VoiceMaster channel creation.
usage: Run `/voicemaster disable`.

name: /serverstats
description: Configure a server automation or member-management feature.
usage: Run the command and select the channel, role or options requested by Discord. Check role hierarchy and permissions.

name: /autorole
description: Configure a server automation or member-management feature.
usage: Run the command and select the channel, role or options requested by Discord. Check role hierarchy and permissions.

name: /ticket setup
description: Create the ticket panel and configure its destination.
usage: Run `/ticket setup` and follow Discord’s prompts to choose the panel channel and support settings.

name: /ticket edit
description: Edit an existing ticket panel or its settings.
usage: Run `/ticket edit` and select the panel/settings to change.

name: /ticket close
description: Close the current ticket.
usage: Run `/ticket close` inside the ticket channel.

name: /ticket add
description: Add a member to the current ticket.
usage: Run `/ticket add` in the ticket channel and select the member.

name: /ticket remove
description: Remove a member from the current ticket.
usage: Run `/ticket remove` and select the member.

name: /ticket rename
description: Rename the current ticket channel.
usage: Run `/ticket rename` in the ticket channel and enter the new name.

name: /ticket claim
description: Claim a ticket so staff know who is handling it.
usage: Run `/ticket claim` in the ticket channel.

name: /ticket list
description: List tickets for the server.
usage: Run `/ticket list` to view ticket records.

name: /giveaway create
description: Start a giveaway with the configured prize and duration.
usage: Run `/giveaway create` and complete the prize, duration, winner-count and channel fields Discord displays.

name: /giveaway panel
description: Open the giveaway management panel.
usage: Run `/giveaway panel` to create or manage giveaways with the interactive controls.

name: /giveaway list
description: View active and past giveaways.
usage: Run `/giveaway list`.
